evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/import/FeedImport.tsx:48 — `const { data: feeds, isLoading } = useFeedSources(agency?.id || '')` destructures the query result without an `isError`/`error` branch. The render at L74-84 only handles `isLoading` (skeleton) and `feeds?.length === 0` (EmptyState); on a transport/server error `feeds` is `undefined`, so `feeds?.length === 0` is `false` and control falls to the else branch where `feeds?.map(...)` yields nothing — the user sees a silent blank `.feeds-list` with no error message and no retry affordance. This is the exact anti-pattern RealtorManagement.tsx was fixed for (Issue #2343, sibling of #2277: 'transport/server error no longer renders the misleading empty state'), and PriceAlerts.tsx:133 handles correctly via an `if (error)` role="alert" block. FeedImport never adopted the fix.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/import/CrmConnection.tsx:50 — `const { data: connections, isLoading } = useCrmConnections(agency?.id || '')` has the same missing-error-branch bug as FeedImport. Render at L76-84 handles only `isLoading` and `connections?.length === 0`; on query failure `connections` is `undefined`, `connections?.length === 0` is `false`, and the else branch's `connections?.map(...)` renders an empty list — a silent failure on the agency CRM-connection management screen with no error UI or retry. Should follow the established reality-web pattern (PriceAlerts.tsx:133 / RealtorManagement.tsx Issue #2343): destructure `isError`/`error` and render a role="alert" error state.
